about_the_game:
Welcome to your new practice. This is where the broken, damned, and dangerous arrive by appointment.

OPEN THE DOOR...

In Knock on the Occult Door, you are a ritual specialist and spiritual confidant for those carrying unbearable secrets. Each client brings grief, rage, or regret and a choice for you to make.

Will you bind them in vengeance, release them in peace, or trap them in their own darkness?

This gothic visual novel unfolds through deep moral decisions, haunting performances, and a branching ritual system where your accessories, intuition, and restraint shape the outcome.

  • You are the occultist. The mirror sees all.

  • Some clients are haunted.

  • Some are hunters.

  • Most are still human but none arrive safely.

  • You do not give advice.

  • You perform bindings.

Each appointment is a test. Choose protective accessories to survive, read their energy, and perform one of three powerful rites. But tread carefully: not all clients want healing. Some may try to manipulate you… and others might try to kill you.

Your tools matter. Your instincts matter more.

No charm is without consequence.

No sigil without a cost.

And not everyone walks out alive.

 FEATURES:

  •   7 unforgettable appointments with layered choices and outcomes

  •   A sentient mirror that exposes your hidden fears and watches every decision

  •   Rituals that bind, trap, release or destroy

  •   Occult accessories that alter dialogue, perception, and consequence

  •   A story driven experience rich in gothic dread and beauty

  •   Permanent consequences you can die during sessions

Every soul has a story. Every binding leaves a mark.

Are you ready to open the door?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes and imagery intended for a mature audience. It includes:

  Dark psychological content involving trauma, guilt, and moral dilemmas
  Depictions of death, grief, and spiritual possession
  References to past violence and implied emotional or physical abuse
  Occult rituals and supernatural entities
  Mild horror elements including unsettling imagery and disturbing atmosphere

While there is no explicit sexual content, some narrative branches may touch on manipulation, betrayal, or obsession in relationships. Player discretion is advised.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: Dual core from Intel or AMD at 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 8600/9600GT, ATI/AMD Radeon HD2600/3600 (Graphic Drivers: nVidia 310, AMD 12.11), OpenGL 2.1
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS 10.7
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card with at least 512MB Shared VRAM & openGL 2.0
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Mac-compatible sound card

short_description: Bind spirits. Weigh their pain. Each client arrives by appointment haunted, broken, or dangerous. In this gothic occult visual novel, you use protective accessories, read signs, and choose bindings that alter fate. Some seek redemption. Others hide darker truths. Your rituals may awaken the dead.
